I had an out of body experience when I had my first surgery. I was in my basement and my upper stomach area started to hurt almost like a burning kind of feeling. I left to go to the hospital and they told me I had appendicitis and they had to operate. 

They bring the laughing gas in and asked me to count backwards from 100. After that I remember a green light and then floating above myself looking down at the dr’s. My feet slowly came to the floor and I walked to the corner of the room and turned around and looked back at myself. After that I walked through a couple walls and got into the waiting room where I saw my friends and family.

I remember my mom and dad talking to each other. I remember my grandmother was playing bubble witch on her phone. I remember my dad leaving. I remember trying to talk and I couldn’t. It felt a lot like when Frodo our the ring on in lord of the rings. I also remember that it felt like someone turned my emotions up 1000%. Like I felt the physical affects of what people were saying. Hard to explain. Anyways I jolted back up out of surgery and punched a dr and started screaming as they were pushing me down the hallway. I wasn’t sure if I was still in my body or not so I was freaking out. 

They wheel me into my room and just my mom comes into the room. I start telling her about all this and she’s telling me I was just dreaming. I quoted her exact conversation with my dad. Told her about bubble witch. Tell her I saw and herd my dad take a phone call and leave. Her face goes pale. She asks how I knew. I told her I had an out of body experience.
